profile.headline: Firmware Developer | Aerospace && Humanoid Robotics Enthusiast | Ex Tesla
profile.summary:
Firmware developer with a background in Mechanical Engineering. 

Leveraging my skills to write and test firmware across a variety of subsystems. Taking ownership of software/hardware debugging and ensuring thermal integrity.

Experience in developing, integrating, and testing sensor drivers.

Former Tesla with experience in Space Robotics, Humanoid Robotics, and Telecom.
